xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5370: Workflow redesign live-check fixes: Issues header overlap, breadcrumb clips file name, Spend never times out, More wraps, model pending off-deck

plan.title: Workflow redesign live-check fixes: Issues header overlap, breadcrumb clips file name, Spend never times out, More wraps, model pending off-deck
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The epic owner's live check of the workflow redesign (C #5290, G #5294) at 1920 x 1000 found five defects: the left column Issues header squeezes its toggle to 0 px so the CI chip draws over the ISSUES eyebrow and the filter wraps; the code pane breadcrumb clips the file name instead of the leading folders; the Spend this week fact waits forever when /api/costs/summary hangs; the Home action row needs 1070 px in a 1048 px row so More wraps; and off the deck the New conversation button says model pending because nothing fetches the settings' default model.
narratives.Proposal: Five leaf fixes, each with its own test: scope a shrinkable chip container into the frame header (identity chip ellipsizes, eyebrow/count/filter never shrink); split the breadcrumb into a truncating leading group and a non-shrinking file segment; route the spend read through fetchWithTimeout with a 20 s timeout and add a spendError prop so the fact shows — / unavailable like Landed; tighten the action row's gap and padding; call ensureDefaultConversationModel once at module load in newConversationDefaults.ts with the existing re-derive rule plus a non-empty guard. Then document the behavior and verify the three layout fixes live with Playwright at 1920 x 1000. Full detail, before/after code and test recipes: .pan/drafts/PAN-5370.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No timeout or error change to useProjectChanges or the Landed fact
- No measured middle-collapse (overdeck › … › frame ›) breadcrumb; end ellipsis on the leading group only
- No change to the Command Deck tree variant of ProjectNode or to the shared .projectCiChip/.projectDeployChip/.projectIdentityChip rules
- No guarantee the action row fits at 1920 px with longer editor labels (e.g. VS Code Insiders) or on macOS; wrapping stays allowed outside the stated configuration
- No server, contract, route or cost-summary performance change (the slow route is PAN-5369)
- No new Playwright spec added to test:playwright; live verification is a one-off probe plus the test role's UAT
- No vi.resetModules + dynamic-import render tests

autoDecisions.summary: Issues header: the identity chip truncates with an ellipsis; CI and deploy chips keep their width; overflow is clipped by a frame-only chip container
autoDecisions.rationale: The live probe showed the 189 px identity chip is what does not fit at 264 px; scoping the override to .frameHeaderChips > .projectIdentityChip leaves the tree variant and HomeMetaLine untouched.

autoDecisions.summary: Breadcrumb: pure-CSS end ellipsis on the leading group instead of a measured middle collapse
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue gives overdeck › … › frame › as an example only; end ellipsis meets 'leading segments truncate first' with no layout code that happy-dom cannot test.

autoDecisions.summary: Spend timeout uses the existing fetchWithTimeout (PAN-1705) with an exported SPEND_TIMEOUT_MS = 20_000; error wins over stale data
autoDecisions.rationale: Reuses the dashboard's one timeout helper; mirrors the Landed fact, whose isError check already wins over data.

autoDecisions.summary: Action row: gap-2 -> gap-1.5 and px-3 -> px-2.5, with an inner-gap fallback gated on a live measurement
autoDecisions.rationale: The probe measured 1070 px needed vs 1048 px available; the two changes save about 40 px, and the issue lists tightening gaps or padding as the first option.

autoDecisions.summary: Default model: keep the issue's module-load fix and add a non-empty guard to the re-derive
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue prescribes the module-load call, and it is the only placement that covers every store reader (useCreateConversation is used from ProjectHome too). The guard is a no-op in production but stops a failed import-time fetch in unit tests from resetting a model set in beforeEach.

autoDecisions.summary: Screenshots go to the gitignored .tmp/pan-5370/ and measurements into the PR description; the test role captures its own UAT screenshots
autoDecisions.rationale: No committed-evidence convention exists for dashboard screenshots; project memory places UX artifacts in .tmp/, and roles/test.md owns UAT screenshots.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-8 (follow its six steps exactly; the recipe was run end to end in planning). Serve the branch frontend with `npx vite --port 3010 --strictPort` from src/dashboard/frontend (3010 is on the server's trusted-origin list; other ports leave the WebSocket refused), open http://localhost:3010/command-deck/overdeck in a fresh isolated Playwright context at 1920 x 1000 dark, measure the toolbar tops/headroom and the frame header, then open a conversation (first conversation-meta-line), press Control+Shift+E and walk the virtualized file tree with the PRD's clickTree helper to src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/frame/LeftColumn.tsx and measure the breadcrumb. If the toolbar wraps or headroom < 16 px, apply D-4's fallback in HomeActions.tsx (ACT_LAYOUT inner gap-2 -> gap-1.5) with trailer `Item: live-layout-verification` and re-measure. Save PNGs and measurements in .tmp/pan-5370/, paste measurements into the PR description, stop Vite, and record the item with `git commit --allow-empty` (measurements in the body, trailer `Item: live-layout-verification`), then push. If port 3010 is busy, do not stop the other process: note it in the PR and still make the empty commit.
